description: Rodinia 3.1 HotSpot3D FP32 recurrence with one-cell mapping, fixed iteration counts, stability-limited timestep when required, and complete FP64 CPU verification.

scaling_param.name: grid_size
scaling_param.description: Grid dimension per axis (NxNxN temperature grid)

non_scaling_params.name: block_size
non_scaling_params.description: Thread-block dimension (BxBxB); each thread updates one cell.

non_scaling_params.name: num_iterations
non_scaling_params.description: Fixed number of time steps per process; one kernel launch per step. The timestep and resulting simulated duration are reported.

non_scaling_params.name: amb_temp
non_scaling_params.description: Ambient temperature (°C). Enters the stencil only as an additive term, so it shifts result values but has no effect on control flow, memory pattern, or timing. Fixed at one value — sweeping it would produce performance-identical runs.

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Run the vector-add warmer once before the timed trajectory. Subsequent dependent steps retain their natural cache state. False disables this entry warmer.
